_disclaimer: Curated, illustrative subset for gate-testing and demonstration purposes only. This is NOT a complete or verified E. coli K-12 essentiality dataset (e.g. it is not the Keio collection or PEC database) and NOT a complete gene identity registry. Absence of a gene from `essential_genes` does not certify it is safe to knock out; absence from `known_genes` should be treated as 'not verifiable in this knowledge base', not 'confirmed nonexistent'. Shared by harness/workflow/gates.py (IdentityGate, BiologicalRuleGate) and workflows/synbio_v01/modules/evaluator.py so both consult one source instead of duplicating a hardcoded list.
foreign_genes_note: Bacillus subtilis genes (sporulation/competence regulators), included only so BiologicalRuleGate's host-range check has a deliberately-wrong test fixture; not related to any real cross-species transfer analysis.
